title: 5 Places That Will Pay You To Move There (Including 1 in Italy)
content:
1. Shoals Area, Alabama
Located near Muscle Shoals Sound Studio, this region launched in June 2019, offered a $10,000 incentive for remote workers to move to the Shoals region (NW Alabama).
The Shoals Economic Development Authority provided the $10,000 in staged installments (25 percent upon relocating, another 25 percent after 6 months, and the remaining 50 percent after one year of residency).
Prospective residents must work remotely or operate their own businesses. The area promises scenic landscapes, small town charm, and a supportive local business scene.
2. Bentonville, Arkansas
As part of the “Life Works Here” initiative (launched in late 2020), Northwest Arkansas offered a $10,000 incentive (paid in cash or Bitcoin) to attract remote tech workers to relocate to the Bentonville area.
With outdoor recreation, a booming local economy, and high quality schools, Bentonville aims to attract skilled professionals and their families.
Selected applicants were required to reside in Northwest Arkansas and were awarded a one-time $10,000 grant (plus a high-end mountain bike) as the relocation incentive.
